title: Longline Mission

nodes.text: Ensure all individuals are trained in longline operations

evidence.source_text: All individuals involved in longline missions will have been trained in longline operations.

nodes.text: Communicate load delivery or pickup location to pilot

evidence.source_text: If you are on the receiving end or backhaul end of a longline load, you must be able to communicate to the pilot where you want the load delivered or picked up.

nodes.text: Use a signal mirror to identify position to pilot

evidence.source_text: Use a signal mirror to identify your position to the pilot.

nodes.text: Ensure drop-off/pick-up area is open and free of obstacles

evidence.source_text: The drop-off/pick-up area should be as open and free of obstacles as possible.

nodes.text: Contact pilot by radio and provide load and site information

evidence.source_text: Once you have contacted the pilot by radio, provide specific load and site information (cargo weight, any hazardous materials, wind speed and direction, etc.).

nodes.text: Mark drop-off spot with flagging (large X on the ground)

evidence.source_text: Mark the drop-off spot with flagging (large X on the ground) if possible.

nodes.text: Keep pilot informed of load status

evidence.source_text: Keep pilot informed of load status (height above the ground, clear of obstacles, etc.).

nodes.text: Let the hook land on the ground before attaching load

evidence.source_text: Let the hook land on the ground before attaching load.

nodes.text: Did the electrical release release the load?

evidence.source_text: If the electrical release does not release the load, you must manually release it; wait until the hook lands on the ground before releasing.

nodes.text: Manually release the load after hook lands on the ground

evidence.source_text: you must manually release it; wait until the hook lands on the ground before releasing.

nodes.text: Connect a swivel to the cargo/longline hook

evidence.source_text: A swivel must be connected to the cargo/longline hook. NO EXCEPTIONS!
When you request nets, request swivels also.

nodes.text: Load cargo net with heavy items in the center, light items on top. Tape all boxes and loose items

evidence.source_text: Load cargo net with heavy items in the center, light items on top. Tape all boxes and loose items.

nodes.text: Pull purse strings of cargo net to equal length and attach a swivel to steel rings

evidence.source_text: Pull the purse strings of the cargo net to equal length and attach a swivel to the steel rings.
Its not necessary to cross the purse strings with an overhand wrap.
